overview_description.description:
Flare is a powerful new blockchain with the first consensus protocol for external data. Decentralized applications on Flare can therefore trustlessly acquire and use information from other blockchains and real world data sources, solving the oracle problem and opening the door to a new era of utility.

> Fast, decentralized and fully-insured bridges can connect smart contract chains multilaterally, unifying rather than fragmenting liquidity.

> Non-smart contract assets such as BTC, XRP and DOGE can be brought on to Flare, and put to work earning yield in DeFi.

> Full cross-chain composability enables decentralized applications to use the value, liquidity and information of multiple blockchains via a single deployment on Flare.

> Seamless decentralized integration with Web2 data powers trustless use of real world data sources in Web3 dapps.

about_short_description.short_description: Flare is a powerful new layer 1 blockchain built for secure decentralized connectivity with other chains and real world data sources.

product.name: Flare Network
product.description: An EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain for decentralized applications that require on-chain access to external blockchain events, price data, and real-world APIs.

product.name: Flare Data Connector
product.description: A blockchain-integrated data attestation service that enables decentralized applications to verify events from external blockchains and real-world APIs.

product.name: Flare Time Series Oracle
product.description: A decentralized oracle that supplies blockchain applications with regularly updated price feeds through data providers and Flare smart contracts.

product.name: FAssets
product.description: A Flare protocol for representing and using assets from external blockchain networks in Flare-based applications, including use cases associated with XRP, Bitcoin, and Dogecoin.

product.name: Flare Infrastructure Provider Program
product.description: A participation service for organizations that validate Flare blocks and provide data to the network’s enshrined protocols in exchange for FLR rewards and applicable fees.

product.name: Flare Portal
product.description: A web-based interface for interacting with Flare accounts, including FLR wrapping, rewards claims, delegation, staking, and governance participation.
